summary.goal: Implement three built-in adapters that read from common data formats and produce SessionData. These are generic — no dependency on any specific project or database. Each implements SessionAdapter including cursor-based incremental processing. Trajectory-file reads .trajectory.json files (the format used by AgentWorkforce/trajectories). Relay-JSONL reads agent-relay message archives (YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl). Transcript reads raw conversation logs (markdown, JSONL, plaintext).

acceptance_criteria.description: Trajectory adapter reads .trajectory.json files from configurable directory (default: .trajectories/)
Trajectory adapter maps: chapters → SessionEvent[] with type chapter_start
Trajectory adapter maps: events (prompts, tool calls) → SessionEvent[]
Trajectory adapter maps: retrospective.decisions → Decision[] with reasoning
Trajectory adapter maps: retrospective.summary → Retrospective
Trajectory adapter maps: artifacts → Artifact[]
Trajectory adapter maps: trail decision entries → Decision[] with pre-structured reasoning (high-value, minimal LLM needed)
Trajectory adapter supports completedOnly config (default: true) to filter by trajectory status
Relay-JSONL adapter reads YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl files from configurable directory
Relay-JSONL adapter maps: agent-to-agent messages → Message[] with agentName populated
Relay-JSONL adapter maps: broadcast messages → Message[] with role system
Relay-JSONL adapter maps: agent spawn/stop events → SessionEvent[] with type agent_spawned
Relay-JSONL adapter supports agentFilter config to limit to specific agents
Transcript adapter reads markdown, JSONL, or plaintext files from configurable path
Transcript adapter parses role/content pairs from each format
All adapters implement listSessions returning available session IDs with optional time range filtering
All adapters implement getCursor/setCursor for incremental processing
Transcript adapter uses explicit format field in config (format: 'markdown' | 'jsonl' | 'plaintext') — no auto-detection of transcript format
Trail decision entries produce Decision objects with Decision.source = 'trail' to mark their origin for downstream pre-structured handling
Relay-JSONL adapter groups continuous message streams into sessions using time-gap based grouping with configurable gap threshold (default: 30 minutes of inactivity)

observations: Trajectory .trajectory.json format has: chapters[], events[], retrospective{decisions[], summary}, artifacts[] — maps cleanly to SessionData
trail decision entries are the highest-signal input: already have title + reasoning → can become nuggets without LLM
Relay JSONL format: one JSON object per line, each with from, to, timestamp, body fields
Relay adapter needs to reconstruct 'sessions' from continuous message logs — grouping by time window or agent lifecycle
Transcript adapter is the simplest: parse role/content pairs, minimal structure
These adapters define what mull works with 'out of the box' — the generic formats any project could produce
Each adapter is a separate file: src/adapters/trajectory.ts, relay.ts, transcript.ts
concerns: Relay JSONL session boundary detection: messages are a continuous stream, need heuristic for session grouping
Transcript format detection: markdown vs JSONL vs plaintext — need format sniffing or explicit config

steps.title: Implement trajectory adapter
steps.description: Build the trajectory adapter that reads .trajectory.json files from a configurable directory (default: .trajectories/). Maps trajectory structure to SessionData: chapters to SessionEvent[] with type chapter_start, events to SessionEvent[], retrospective.decisions to Decision[] with reasoning, retrospective.summary to Retrospective, artifacts to Artifact[]. Trail decision entries produce Decision objects with Decision.source = 'trail' to mark their origin for downstream pre-structured nugget handling. Supports completedOnly config (default: true) to filter by trajectory status. Implements listSessions, loadSession, getCursor, setCursor.

acceptance_criteria.description: Reads .trajectory.json files from configurable directory (default: .trajectories/)
Maps chapters to SessionEvent[] with type chapter_start, including chapter title and timestamp
Maps events (prompts, tool calls) to SessionEvent[] with appropriate event types
Maps retrospective.decisions to Decision[] preserving reasoning field
Maps trail decision entries to Decision[] with Decision.source = 'trail' marker
Maps retrospective.summary to Retrospective and artifacts to Artifact[]
completedOnly config (default: true) filters trajectories by completion status
listSessions returns file-derived session IDs with time range support

steps.specification: Location: src/adapters/trajectory.ts. Class TrajectoryAdapter implements SessionAdapter. Config type: TrajectoryAdapterConfig = { dir: string, completedOnly?: boolean }. Trail decisions identified by entries in the trajectory that have a 'trail' or 'decision' type marker — set Decision.source = 'trail' on these. File-based session IDs derived from trajectory filenames.

steps.title: Implement relay-JSONL adapter
steps.description: Build the relay-JSONL adapter that reads YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl files from a configurable directory. Each JSONL line is a JSON object with from, to, timestamp, body fields. Maps agent-to-agent messages to Message[] with agentName populated, broadcast messages to Message[] with role system, and agent spawn/stop events to SessionEvent[] with type agent_spawned. Groups continuous message streams into sessions using time-gap based grouping with configurable gap threshold (default: 30 minutes of inactivity). Supports agentFilter config to limit to specific agents.

acceptance_criteria.description: Reads YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl files from configurable directory
Maps agent-to-agent messages to Message[] with agentName populated from 'from' field
Maps broadcast messages to Message[] with role 'system'
Maps agent spawn/stop events to SessionEvent[] with type 'agent_spawned'
Groups messages into sessions using time-gap based grouping: a gap of >= configurable threshold (default 30 min) between consecutive messages starts a new session
agentFilter config limits output to messages involving specified agents
listSessions returns session IDs derived from date files and gap-based grouping

steps.specification: Location: src/adapters/relay.ts. Class RelayJsonlAdapter implements SessionAdapter. Config type: RelayAdapterConfig = { dir: string, agentFilter?: string[], sessionGapMinutes?: number }. Default sessionGapMinutes: 30. Session IDs formatted as 'relay-{date}-{index}' where index is the session number within that day. Parse each line with JSON.parse, skip malformed lines with warning.

steps.title: Implement transcript adapter
steps.description: Build the transcript adapter that reads raw conversation logs from a configurable path. Supports three formats specified by explicit format field in config: 'markdown' (## Role: content blocks), 'jsonl' (one JSON object per line with role/content fields), and 'plaintext' (line-based with role prefix patterns). No auto-detection of format — the config must specify which format to use. Parses role/content pairs into Message[]. Implements listSessions, loadSession, getCursor, setCursor.

acceptance_criteria.description: Reads files from configurable path
Config requires explicit format field: 'markdown' | 'jsonl' | 'plaintext' — no auto-detection
Markdown format: parses ## Role\ncontent blocks into Message[]
JSONL format: parses {role, content} JSON objects per line into Message[]
Plaintext format: parses 'Role: content' line patterns into Message[]
listSessions returns file-derived session IDs
Throws descriptive error if format field is missing from config

steps.specification: Location: src/adapters/transcript.ts. Class TranscriptAdapter implements SessionAdapter. Config type: TranscriptAdapterConfig = { path: string, format: 'markdown' | 'jsonl' | 'plaintext' }. Each file is one session. Session ID derived from filename (stem without extension). For markdown: split on /^## \w+/m. For JSONL: JSON.parse each line. For plaintext: regex /^(\w+):\s+(.+)$/.

steps.title: Write adapter tests
steps.description: Comprehensive test suite for all three built-in adapters. Tests trajectory adapter mapping correctness (chapters, events, decisions, trail decisions with source='trail', retrospective, artifacts, completedOnly filtering). Tests relay-JSONL adapter message mapping, session grouping by time gap, agentFilter, broadcast handling. Tests transcript adapter for all three formats, explicit format requirement, error on missing format. Tests cursor-based incremental loading for each adapter.

acceptance_criteria.description: Trajectory adapter tests: chapter mapping, event mapping, decision mapping with trail source marker, retrospective mapping, artifact mapping, completedOnly filtering
Relay adapter tests: message mapping with agentName, broadcast as system role, spawn events, time-gap session grouping at 30min default and custom thresholds, agentFilter
Transcript adapter tests: markdown parsing, JSONL parsing, plaintext parsing, error when format missing from config
Incremental loading tests: cursor-based filtering returns only data after cursor timestamp for each adapter
Edge case tests: empty files, malformed JSONL lines (skipped with warning), missing directories

steps.specification: Location: src/adapters/__tests__/trajectory.test.ts, relay.test.ts, transcript.test.ts. Use Vitest. Create fixture files in __tests__/fixtures/ for each adapter format. Use tmp directories for cursor tests. Mock filesystem where appropriate for isolation.
